mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation remains below 2% during the signal period, indicating that wage pressures are not spilling over into broad price inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the Industrial Production Index, signals a supply-side recovery that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM Manufacturing PMI remains below 50 during the signal period, indicating that the production rebound is not broadly based.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, as measured by the month-over-month change in the Retail and Food Services Sales series, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence index rises during the signal period, indicating that the retail sales drop is likely transient.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate, combined with a flattening yield curve, signals a tightening financial conditions that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 earnings yield remains above the 10-year Treasury yield during the signal period, indicating that equities are still attractive relative to bonds.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating pace of job growth, as measured by the 3-month moving average of the month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims rise by more than 10% during the signal period, indicating that the labor market is weakening.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts, as measured by the month-over-month change in the Housing Starts series, signals a strengthening housing sector that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 30-year fixed mortgage rates rise by more than 50 basis points during the signal period, indicating that housing affordability is deteriorating.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the ISM Manufacturing PMI below 50, combined with a rise in the unemployment rate, signals a weakening industrial sector and a deteriorating labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Durable goods orders rise by more than 5% during the signal period, indicating that the industrial slowdown is likely transient.
